# hri_servers (Data Source)

Reads the account inventory and returns server numbers, with optional filters.

## Example Usage

```terraform
terraform {
  required_providers {
    hri = { source = "withlogicco/hri" }
  }
}

provider "hri" {}

data "hri_servers" "all" {
  dc                = "NBG1-DC1"
  product           = "DS 3000"
  name_regex        = "^db-"
  include_cancelled = false
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `dc` (String) Filter by Robot data center.
- `include_cancelled` (Boolean) Include cancelled servers. Defaults to false.
- `name_regex` (String) Filter server names using a Go regular expression.
- `product` (String) Filter by product name.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) Inventory snapshot identifier.
- `server_numbers` (Set of Number) Server numbers matching the filters.
